title: Handle fresh Orb adoption preflights
body:
## Summary

- skip the archived-thread inventory when every requested thread is already confirmed active
- treat a confirmed absent tmux server as an empty global pane inventory
- preserve fail-closed behavior for unresolved threads and real tmux inspection failures

## Orb native-create → adopt evidence

One native Orb thread was created with explicit `executor=orb` and `mode=medium`: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019fa091-6570-72ca-95d0-70189c0c2277

The merged adoption primitive initially failed before mutation on two fresh-Orb conditions:

1. the redundant `--include-archived` inventory exceeded the bounded 64 KiB output on a large account;
2. with no tmux server yet, global pane inspection returned the expected missing-socket error instead of an empty inventory.

With this patch, the same exact thread was adopted without another creation or any TUI delivery. Verification reported `local=exact remote=active`, the exact tmux pane remained alive in the canonical workdir, and an identical adoption replay returned the expected idempotent skip.

## Validation

- focused archive-status, tmux absence, aggregate/worker doctor, and adoption tests
- `go test ./... -count=1`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go build ./...`
- gofmt and `git diff --check`

Related to #269
